question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id
  FROM olist_orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
seller_customer_counts AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT do2.customer_id) as distinct_customers
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON oi.order_id = do2.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_profit AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price - oi.freight_value) as total_profit
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON oi.order_id = do2.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_order_counts AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) as distinct_orders
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON oi.order_id = do2.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_five_star AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(*) as five_star_ratings
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON oi.order_id = do2.order_id
  JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.review_score = 5
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
)
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct customers' as achievement, seller_id, CAST(distinct_customers AS BIGINT) as value
FROM (SELECT seller_id, distinct_customers FROM seller_customer_counts ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest profit (price minus freight_value)', seller_id, ROUND(total_profit, 2) as value
FROM (SELECT seller_id, total_profit FROM seller_profit ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct orders', seller_id, CAST(distinct_orders AS BIGINT) as value
FROM (SELECT seller_id, distinct_orders FROM seller_order_counts ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, CAST(five_star_ratings AS BIGINT) as value
FROM (SELECT seller_id, five_star_ratings FROM seller_five_star ORDER BY five_star_ratings DESC LIMIT 1)
